acceptance.scope: Descriptive crop-weighted regression score with frozen policy; not the independent-component bound or a future accuracy guarantee.

grouped_uncertainty.scope: Descriptive conditional 95% percentile intervals on the previously inspected assessment. Components, rather than crops, are resampled jointly. Fixed models/seeds are not resampled. No post-selection correction, fresh-test claim or deployment guarantee.

findings.finding: No model-quality improvement is demonstrated. C4 mean assessment Macro-F1 is lower than C0 by 0.00833892748; the paired component interval crosses zero. Preset seed 314 also scores below original C0 seed 314. Keep validation-selected C4 as the study output without choosing a replacement using assessment.

All 327 assessment cases were previously inspected. New results are exploratory regression evidence, not a fresh blind test. The original calibration was also historically inspected; conditional corrected bounds do not establish a future 95% accuracy guarantee.
Overfitting remains: late fit accuracy approaches 1 while clean selection CE rises. Stronger dropout C4 did not establish improved generalization; do not present every modeling shortcoming as solved.

Choice freeze is hash-bound and executed before assessment in captured source. JSON records do not contain a separate externally authenticated wall-clock audit for every phase; chronology is source/control-flow evidence, not an external timestamp attestation.
Local ready gates cover CPU FP32 parity, prepared PNG crop Predictor and in-process ASGI contracts only. They are not hosted uptime, production load or arbitrary-photo quality evidence.
